criteria.floss_license_justification: The Apache-2.0 license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
criteria.floss_license_osi_justification: The Apache-2.0 license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
criteria.english_justification: Documentation, contribution instructions and issue templates are in English. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
criteria.maintained_justification: Active main commits, issue resolutions and releases through v0.10.0. This criterion differs from Scorecard's 90-day history heuristic. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/commits/main/
criteria.repo_public_justification: Repository on GitHub, which provides public git repositories with URLs.
criteria.repo_track_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git can track the changes, who made them, and when they were made.
criteria.repo_interim_justification: Public pull requests and main history include changes between releases. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
criteria.repo_distributed_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git is distributed.
criteria.version_unique_justification: Immutable versioned tags and Maven coordinates; publication refuses existing versions. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/tools/release/publish.sh
criteria.version_semver_justification: Release identifiers use major.minor.patch with optional prerelease suffixes; currently 0.x. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/releases
criteria.release_notes_justification: Non-trivial release notes file in repository: <https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md>.
criteria.report_responses_justification: As of 2026-11-09 both bug-labelled issues (#13, #29) were fixed/closed with linked PRs (#14, #46). Repository created 2026-11-03: this is its complete available history, not a claim of months of activity. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Abug
criteria.enhancement_responses_justification: As of 2026-11-09 five of seven enhancement-labelled issues were resolved (#17, #18, #19, #23, #24); #25/#26 remain open. Repository created 2026-11-03; only its available history is claimed. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Aenhancement
criteria.report_archive_justification: Public issue and PR history retains reports, linked fixes and discussion. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/issues?q=is%3Aissue
criteria.build_common_tools_justification: Bazel/Bazelisk with checked-in targets and pinned Java toolchains. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/docs/BAZEL.md
criteria.build_floss_tools_justification: Local builds use Bazel and the pinned OpenJDK/GraalVM toolchain; BuildBuddy service credentials are not required with --config=local. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/docs/BAZEL.md
criteria.test_most_justification: Production line and branch coverage each have a 99.8% gate, plus complete pinned CEL conformance and negative cases. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/docs/COVERAGE.md
criteria.test_continuous_integration_justificatio: CI runs on pull requests and pushes to main. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
criteria.tests_are_added_justification: Recent functionality includes regression tests, e.g. canonical AST/runtime/compiled negative tests in PR #46 and optional-RE2/J consumer tests. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/pull/46/files
criteria.warnings_justification: Explicit javac unchecked/deprecation warnings and CodeQL analysis of Java, Python and Actions. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/.bazelrc
criteria.warnings_fixed_justification: First-party warnings are fixed or narrowly justified; upstream protobuf implementation/generated conformance warnings are documented, not hidden by changing the corpus. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/docs/SECURE_DEVELOPMENT.md
criteria.know_secure_design_justification: Primary developer Sam Gammon confirmed understanding of the secure design principles on 2026-11-09. Project-specific applications and review expectations: https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/docs/SECURE_DEVELOPMENT.md
criteria.know_common_errors_justification: Primary developer Sam Gammon confirmed knowledge of relevant vulnerability classes and mitigations on 2026-11-09. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/docs/SECURE_DEVELOPMENT.md
criteria.delivery_unsigned_justification: Download digests are pinned in source or retrieved over HTTPS; no plain-HTTP checksum is trusted. Legacy Maven MD5/SHA-1 sidecars are compatibility metadata, not authentication. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/docs/SECURE_DEVELOPMENT.md
criteria.vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: 2026-11-09 audit found no open Dependabot or CodeQL vulnerability alerts; no project advisories. Maintainer confirmed no reports received. SECURITY.md requires remediation within the public-disclosure window. Custom dependency review limits are documented. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/docs/MAINTENANCE.md
criteria.vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerability reports or open alerts as of 2026-11-09; policy prioritizes confirmed critical issues immediately and blocks releases while unresolved. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/SECURITY.md
criteria.no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub secret scanning and push protection enabled; zero open secret alerts in the 2026-11-09 audit. Credentials are excluded from source and must never be logged. This is not a proof that any scanner detects all secrets. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/AGENTS.md
criteria.static_analysis_justification: CodeQL security-extended analyzes Java, Python and Actions on PRs/main and weekly; release qualification requires inspecting results. Java source-only analysis limitations are documented. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml
criteria.static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL security-extended queries detect common vulnerabilities. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml
criteria.static_analysis_fixed_justification: No open CodeQL vulnerability findings at the 2026-11-09 audit. Confirmed medium/higher exploitable findings follow the remediation policy. Scorecard process alerts are tracked separately. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/SECURITY.md
criteria.static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on each main push and pull request, plus weekly. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml
criteria.dynamic_analysis_justification: CI runs coverage-guided Jazzer; daily campaigns run 100,000 inputs per target. Targets cover parser/preparation/AST/decoders and bounded evaluator oracles. Release qualification inspects results. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/tools/fuzz/smoke.sh
criteria.dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Jazzer JVM enables -ea; targets check explicit invariants and independent expected evaluator results, and fail on unexpected exceptions. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/tools/fuzz/BUILD.bazel
criteria.dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No outstanding Jazzer findings in the retained successful campaigns; confirmed exploitable findings follow the same remediation policy as external reports. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/SECURITY.md
criteria.release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known assigned project vulnerabilities at the 2026-11-09 audit. Future fixed CVE/GHSA identifiers must appear in release notes under https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/SECURITY.md
criteria.vulnerability_report_response_justificat: Sam Gammon confirmed on 2026-11-09 that no TruffleCEL vulnerability reports have been received through any channel since project creation. GitHub advisories list was also empty. Reassess after the first report; policy: https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/SECURITY.md
criteria.warnings_strict_justification: Unchecked/deprecation warnings and CodeQL are enabled. All javac warnings and -Werror are not enabled globally; pinned protobuf sources/generated group fixtures require upstream compatibility. This is a SUGGESTED criterion, not a Passing blocker. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/docs/SECURE_DEVELOPMENT.md
criteria.crypto_published_justification: The delivered CEL library implements no cryptographic protocol, key management, password storage or nonce generation. Release-tool checksums use standard hashlib and HTTPS; legacy MD5/SHA-1 sidecars are not security mechanisms. https://github.com/elide-dev/trufflecel/blob/main/docs/SECURE_DEVELOPMENT.md
